|notes=The printed Limited card reads “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Immune to attrition &lt; 5 if Han, Chewie or Lando piloting. Has ship-docking capability.” ([[:File:Premiere-L-millenniumfalcon-hires.webp|600 dpi scan]]). [[Millennium Falcon (Unlimited)|Premiere Unlimited]] (April 1996) added “Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.” to the game text of unique unpiloted starships.<ref name="encyc-unlimited">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=35 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 35, Premiere Unlimited, “Revisions”: “the unique, unpiloted starships (such as Black 2, Black 3, Vader’s Custom TIE, Gold 1, Gold 5, Millennium Falcon, etc.) had the rule about requiring a pilot to use added directly into their game text.” Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive] (8 October 2026).</ref> The Decipher.com card image ([[:File:Premiere-L-millenniumfalcon-decipher-archive.gif]]) has the black Limited border but prints that later sentence.
